gloss: professional; a person with specialized expertise or someone who does something for a living

definitions.gloss: professional; a person with specialized expertise or someone who does something for a living
definitions.explanation: Can be used as a noun (a professional) or as a na-adjective (professional-quality).

examples.japanese: プロフェッショナルな⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プロフェッショナルだ。
examples.english: She is a professional when it comes to cooking.

examples.japanese: プロフェッショナル⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}んで→積む：02294_tsumu⟧きた。
examples.english: I have built up many years of experience as a professional.

notes:
A loanword from English "professional." Used to describe someone with high-level expertise in their field, or the quality of being skilled and competent. Often implies dedication and pride in one's craft beyond mere employment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プロフェッショナルな⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: professional mindset
- プロフェッショナルな⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: professional response/handling
- プロフェッショナル⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誇|ほこ}り→誇り：03623_hokori⟧: pride as a professional
- プロフェッショナル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流儀|りゅうぎ}→流儀：13364_ryuugi⟧: the ways of a professional

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧: pro (common abbreviation, more casual)
- ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧: specialist, expert
- ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧: craftsman, artisan
- ⟦アマチュア→アマチュア：10730_amachua⟧: amateur (antonym)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The NHK TV documentary series "プロフェッショナル ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流儀|りゅうぎ}→流儀：13364_ryuugi⟧" (Professionals: The Ways of Work) has made this word widely familiar. The full form プロフェッショナル carries more weight and formality than the abbreviation ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧.
